name: Fortnite (Battle Royale)

scale.why: the wiki gives metres; values as given (Unreal units are centimetres)

speed.note: running; sprinting 6.47 m/s, crouch-running 4.18 m/s, slow jog 2 m/s

dash.note: no dash (some seasons' items add one)

grapple.note: grapples are seasonal items, not standard movement

extras: seasonal mobility items (grapples, launch pads, shockwave grenades)
notes: Speeds from the Fortnite Wiki's movement-state table (a Pocket Tactics test over 1,836 m agreed: 5:39 actual against 5:35 predicted at 5.48 m/s). Gravity, jump and acceleration aren't published.

sources.title: Pocket Tactics: racing across the Fortnite map
